column6: The earth fell still, and quiet returned to the labyrinth.
With Dark Slayer, its light gone, in his hand,
the young man left the labyrinth.
On the survey team's report, the Republic's council
blamed the disasters on magic stored in the labyrinth,
and reported that the situation was settling.
In Traujito the rebuilding was already under way.
The young man set out for his homeland.
People paused in their work to see him off.
